entries.title: Romans 16:6
segments: Mary. Probably a Gentile convert.

entries.title: Romans 16:7
segments: Andronicus and Junias. The first is a Greek name, the second it Latin; but both men were Jews.  It was the custom of Jews who traveled or engaged in commerce to assume Latin or Greek names.  These two probably belonged, as did Paul, to the tribe of Benjamin, but there is no evidence that they were closely related to Paul.  The only relative mentioned is his nephew (

Stachys . . . Apelles . . . Aristobulus. Greek names.

entries.title: Romans 16:11
segments: Herodion, my kinsman. A Greek name.  See note on

Narcissus. Supposed to be a well-known Roman freedman.

entries.title: Romans 16:12
segments: Tryphaena and Tryphosa. Probably two sisters.  Their names are Greek, as is also that of Persis.

entries.title: Romans 16:13
segments: Rufus. A Latin name.  This Rufus may have been the same as he who is mentioned in

.
 

 
The chosen in the Lord. He who by his faith and example is honored for his work in the Lord.

entries.title: Romans 16:14
segments: Asyncritus, etc.  The names are all Greek.

entries.title: Romans 16:15
segments: Philologus, etc.  All the names are Greek, except 'Julia' a Latin name.  Julia was probably either the wife or sister of Philologus (lover of wisdom).

entries.title: Romans 16:17
segments: Them that are causing the divisions, etc.  The Judaizing teachers within the church (
).  Some scholars think that other forms of error were meant.

entries.title: Romans 16:18
segments: Their own belly. Their objectionable religious notions and schemes.  See

entries.title: Romans 16:19
segments:
Your obedience is come abroad, etc.  Your loyalty to Christian truth is everywhere known.
 

 
Simple unto that which is evil. Uncontaminated by evil, though knowing its danger.

entries.title: Romans 16:20
segments:
The God of peace. Invoked by the apostle with reference to the strife and divisions of which he had just spoken.
 

 
Shall bruise Satan. Shall enable you to triumph over him.
 

 
Shortly. In view of the expected Second Coming of Christ (

entries.title: Romans 16:22
segments: Tertius. Paul's amanuensis, who wrote the apostle's letters from dictation.  His sudden interruption here in order to add his own name to those who wished to salute his Christian brethren in Rome is dramatic.

Erastus. A Greek name.
 

 
City. Corinth.
 

 
Quartus. A Latin name.

entries.title: Romans 16:25
segments:
To establish you. Make firm and steadfast.
 

 
My gospel. Paul's teaching of the salvation by faith for Jew and Gentile.
 

 
The preaching of Jesus Christ. The preaching done in the name of Jesus Christ by Paul and the other apostles.
 

 
The revelation of the mystery. The making known of the secret purpose of God was followed by the proclamation of the gospel.

entries.title: Romans 16:26
segments: Unto obedience of faith. The humble submission which faith implies.
